items.q: Add the odd numbers in order, starting from 1, and look at the sums: 1 + 3 = 4, 1 + 3 + 5 = 9 and 1 + 3 + 5 + 7 + 9 = 25.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Write your answer to part a as a power with exponent 2. Type it with the ^ key.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Use the pattern to find the sum of the first 13 odd numbers, 1 + 3 + 5 and so on up to 25.

a: b) There are 9 odd numbers in part a, and 81 = 9 × 9 = 9².
c) Count the odd numbers from 1 to 25: (25 + 1) ÷ 2 = 13, so there are 13 of them.
13² = 169, so adding the first 13 odd numbers gives 169.
items.hint: Count how many odd numbers you are adding, then compare with the sums shown. Add part a twice on paper, once from the left and once from the right, and check that both totals match.
